footer.tagline: Professional software project cost estimation and planning tool.
footer.disclaimerBody: Projecto Calculator provides high-level estimates for web and mobile application development based on typical industry practices, average market rates, and the inputs you provide. All calculations are indicative only and should not be interpreted as fixed quotes, contractual offers, or professional advice. Actual project cost and delivery time may vary depending on scope changes, technical complexity, team structure and experience, third-party services and integrations, and project management and execution approach.

home.faq1A: Projecto Calculator estimates are based on role-based effort benchmarks and typical development workloads. They provide a realistic planning range, but final cost and delivery time may vary depending on scope, requirements, technical choices, and execution.
home.faq2Q: Is this a fixed price quote?
home.faq2A: No. The results are not a quote and are not binding. They are intended to support early planning and budgeting, not to serve as a contractual offer.
home.faq3Q: What types of projects does Projecto Calculator support?
home.faq4Q: Can I use this for client proposals?
home.faq4A: Yes. Many agencies and freelancers use Projecto Calculator for early estimates and internal planning. For client-facing proposals, we recommend validating the output with detailed scoping before finalizing price and timeline.
home.faq5Q: Do you store my project data?
home.faq5A: Projecto Calculator does not require you to submit sensitive project data. Calculator inputs are used only to generate estimates and improve the experience. If you contact us directly, your contact details are used solely to respond to your inquiry.
home.faq6Q: Will the calculator improve over time?
home.faq6A: Yes. Projecto Calculator is continuously refined using updated benchmarks, industry trends, and feedback to improve accuracy and usability.
home.faq7A: Projecto Calculator uses role-based effort modeling combined with feature-level complexity scoring and design scope inputs. Total effort is converted into cost using role-specific rates and the selected team composition. Planning buffers are applied to reflect real-world delivery, and results are presented as ranges rather than fixed numbers.

about.title: About Projecto Calculator
about.p1: Projecto Calculator is an independent online service designed to help teams and businesses estimate software projects more clearly and efficiently. It turns a few structured inputs — team composition, design scope, feature set, technology stack, and quality assurance — into a realistic cost and timeline range.
about.p2: Modern digital products require accurate planning, clear scope definition, and transparency around technology choices and team composition. While many estimates are created manually or scattered across documents, Projecto Calculator provides a structured way to define project scope, technology stack, team roles, timelines, and cost estimates in one place.
about.p3: The platform allows users to create and manage project estimates based on their own inputs. We focus on clarity, structure, and consistency — helping users turn ideas into well-defined project plans that are easy to review, share, and refine.
about.estimateBody: Estimates combine role-based effort benchmarks with feature-level complexity scoring and design scope. Total effort is converted into cost using role-specific rates and the selected team composition, with planning buffers applied to reflect real-world delivery. Results are presented as ranges rather than fixed numbers, because real projects vary by scope clarity, integrations, compliance requirements, and execution.
about.notBody: Projecto Calculator does not provide development, hiring, or project management services. The website exists solely as an estimation and planning tool that helps users organize project-related information at their request. It is an independent product and is not affiliated with any software vendors, development agencies, or third-party platforms.
about.whoBody: Founders, startup teams, product managers, agencies, CTOs, and software buyers who need a clear, well-organized starting point for budgeting and early planning.
about.openSourceBody: Projecto Calculator is built with Next.js, TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, and jsPDF, and is published under the MIT License.
about.openSourceLink: Read more on the open-source page.

cookie.title: Cookie Policy
cookie.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Projecto Calculator ("we", "us") uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit projecto-calculator.com. It should be read together with our
cookie.s1Body: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work, to improve performance, and to provide information to the site owners and, in some cases, to advertising partners.
cookie.s2Essential: Essential cookies — required for core site functionality and to remember your cookie preferences.
cookie.s2Analytics: Analytics cookies — help us understand how visitors use the site (via Google Analytics / Google Tag Manager) so we can improve it.
cookie.s2Advertising: Advertising cookies — set by Google AdSense and its partners to serve and measure ads, and (with consent) to personalize them.
cookie.s3Body: We use Google AdSense to display advertising. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this and other websites.
cookie.s3Item1: Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visits to this site and/or other sites on the internet.
cookie.s3Item2: Google uses the DoubleClick / DART cookie and similar identifiers to do this.
cookie.s3Item3Pre: You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting
cookie.s4Body1: When you first visit the site, a consent message (provided through Google's certified Consent Management Platform) lets you accept or reject non-essential (analytics and advertising) cookies. We apply Google Consent Mode and default advertising and analytics storage to denied until you opt in. For visitors in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland, personalized ads are only enabled with your consent.
cookie.s4Body2: You can also control or delete cookies through your browser settings at any time. Blocking some cookies may affect how the site functions.
cookie.s5Body: We may update this Cookie Policy to reflect changes in technology, law, or our practices. The "last updated" date above indicates the latest revision.
